mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity through different mechanisms (SSRI and MAOI), creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome and potentially life-threatening hypertensive crisis.
action: Absolutely contraindicated; do not combine; observe 14-day washout period after tranylcypromine before starting escitalopram, or 5-7 days after escitalopram before starting tranylcypromine due to escitalopram's active metabolites.
